looks.description_en: 50% gray Y′ 150.8/255 (+23.3 code values); 25–75% gray span ratio 1.065; mid-gray red minus blue +4.5 code values. Light/medium/deep skin swatches: #F7E0CA, #DDA981, #9A5D28. Red/green/blue swatches: #E33020, #5EC242, #7267D8.
looks.suggested_use_zh: 暖色生活、餐饮与怀旧试片
looks.suggested_use_en: Compare on your own SDR product, portrait and landscape footage before selecting.
looks.cautions_zh: 逐项比较肤色与品牌色，强度过高可能改变产品颜色。仅像素颜色映射，不生成颗粒、光晕、暗角、空间雾或美颜；未做自然画质验收。
looks.cautions_en: Pixel color mapping only; no grain, glow, vignette, spatial haze or beauty effects. Natural footage quality is unaccepted. Check skin/product colors and clipped output.

looks.summary_zh: 中性 · 提亮中灰 · 中段拉开
looks.description_zh: 50% 灰输出 Y′ 151.7/255（变化 +24.2 码值）；25%–75% 灰跨度比 1.076。中灰红减蓝 +2.5 码值。浅/中/深肤色色块分别输出 #EFDACF、#D7AB8C、#A05E2E；红/绿/蓝测试块分别输出 #D73A2A、#81C587、#5454D0。
looks.description_en: 50% gray Y′ 151.7/255 (+24.2 code values); 25–75% gray span ratio 1.076; mid-gray red minus blue +2.5 code values. Light/medium/deep skin swatches: #EFDACF, #D7AB8C, #A05E2E. Red/green/blue swatches: #D73A2A, #81C587, #5454D0.
looks.suggested_use_zh: 产品、生活与风景对照试片
looks.suggested_use_en: Compare on your own SDR product, portrait and landscape footage before selecting.
looks.cautions_zh: 逐项比较肤色与品牌色，强度过高可能改变产品颜色。仅像素颜色映射，不生成颗粒、光晕、暗角、空间雾或美颜；未做自然画质验收。
looks.cautions_en: Pixel color mapping only; no grain, glow, vignette, spatial haze or beauty effects. Natural footage quality is unaccepted. Check skin/product colors and clipped output.

looks.cautions_zh: 逐项比较肤色与品牌色，强度过高可能改变产品颜色。仅像素颜色映射，不生成颗粒、光晕、暗角、空间雾或美颜；未做自然画质验收。
looks.cautions_en: Pixel color mapping only; no grain, glow, vignette, spatial haze or beauty effects. Natural footage quality is unaccepted. Check skin/product colors and clipped output.
